hotels.title: Bali's First-Ever Beachfront Resort by Ovolo with Rooftop Bar & Pool
hotels.description: If it’s a Bali escape that you have been dreaming about, there is just one name you need to know - Mamaka by Ovolo - a stylish urban resort right in the beating heart of Kuta Legian. Drop your bags and arrive at this ultra-cool, beachside haven complete with all the cutting-edge Ovolo touches you would expect from this renowned collection of hotels. As the very first Ovolo property in Bali, Mamaka by Ovolo raises the bar with its suite of incredible offerings sure to wow guests. It all starts with maximalist décor that packs a punch as geometric patterns grace the walls and cool blue hues reflect the beachside environment. Then, there are the exquisite facilities including a stylish wellness centre where guests can sweat it out with included boot camp or yoga classes, freshen up your party shirt at the self-service 24-hour laundry or plunge into the rooftop pool, located at Mamaka Rooftop Bar & Pool, that runs parallel to the ocean. When hunger strikes, pull up a seat at Street 32, a vibrant split-level restaurant slinging classic Asian dishes with a modern spin. When you want to delve into the history and culture of this incredible island, visit the Uluwatu Temple or, for a change of scenery, the magical rainforest and terraced rice paddies of Ubud, both of which are within an hours’ drive.

hotels.title: Stylish Kuta Beachfront Escape with Sparkling Infinity Pool, Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Soak up the sun-drenched allure of Bali's popular Kuta Beach from this design-forward luxury stay, overlooking the shimmering waters of the Indian Ocean. Blending effortless Balinese charm with a social club-inspired atmosphere, the hotel's chic interiors, plush rooms and lavish amenities ensure an unforgettable escape, mere steps from Kuta's golden sands. Spend your days indulging in Kuta's iconic sun, surf and sand, explore colourful markets and sample street food at nearby warungs. Return to your hotel's rooftop to enjoy a refreshing dip in the infinity pool and catch epic beach sunsets, all while savouring laidback bites and sipping on well-crafted cocktails at Afterglow Bar & Kitchen.

hotels.title: Stylish Kuta Beachfront Escape with Rooftop Pool, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Discover unique, design-driven luxury with a stylish stay on Kuta Beach, framed by showstopping views of the shimmering Indian Ocean. This calypso-cool, social club-inspired retreat - part of the renowned Accor Hotels - has everything you need for an unforgettable escape, all just steps from the golden shores of one of Bali’s best beaches. After days spent soaking up Kuta Beach’s legendary sun, surf and sand, return to the hotel’s rooftop for laid-back bites and beanbag sessions at Afterglow Bar & Kitchen, or admire each spectacular sunset by the stunning infinity pool. When you’re ready to explore, Kuta is a traveller’s playground with countless adventures - you’ll be moments away from the boutique-filled open-air gardens of Beachwalk Shopping Centre, and countless eclectic treasures at Kuta and Legian art markets.

hotels.title: Comfortable Kuta Stay with Onsite Bar & Restaurant
hotels.description: Step into the heart of Kuta with a stay at this comfortable retreat, with the lively energy of Kuta Beach and Waterbon Bali's thrilling slides nearby. Whether it's for business or leisure, ibis Bali Kuta provides the perfect accommodation for a relaxing stay. After exploring the bustling local markets or catching a sunset at the beach, recharge with international and Indonesian favourites at Rendez-Vous or enjoy a casual drink at the onsite bar.
